Pure color math and design-token snapshots from MUI 9.5.0 preserve existing CMS colors, shadows and typography. These are local compatibility data/functions, not a MUI runtime dependency. License retained in LICENSE. theme-defaults.json captures the configured Lumen default colors and Nunito typography.

`rewards.js` contains the framework-independent canvas engine and balloon,
confetti and emoji effects from react-rewards 3.0.0. The React import and
`useReward` hook are omitted; the native `fire` entrypoint is exported.
Its MIT license is retained in `rewards.LICENSE`.
